name: FourierPeakMask
label: Fourier Peak Mask
description: Keep only the reciprocal-space volumes around selected peaks and transform back to real space, the equivalent of selected-area electron diffraction. With Auto-detect Peaks on, the peaks are found by thresholding the spectrum's normalized log magnitude (what 'Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)' shows) and taking the strongest voxel of each region above the threshold, skipping the center; the peaks found are written into Peak Centers, so uncheck Auto-detect to review or edit them. Otherwise enter peaks by hand or from a CSV, reading their (x, y, z) voxel indices off a 'Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)' branch. Soft spherical windows (erf edges) are applied around each peak and, optionally, its Friedel mate mirrored through the spectrum center.

parameters.name: auto_detect
parameters.label: Auto-detect Peaks
parameters.description: Find the peaks automatically instead of using the typed or CSV centers below.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.label: Threshold
parameters.description: Fraction of the maximum normalized log magnitude, as displayed by 'Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)', above which voxels belong to a peak. Preview it with a Threshold visualization on a 'Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)' branch.

parameters.name: exclude_center_radius
parameters.label: Exclude Center Radius (bins)
parameters.description: Peaks within this distance of the spectrum center (the DC term and low frequencies) are ignored.

parameters.name: min_peak_size
parameters.label: Min Peak Size (voxels)
parameters.description: Regions above the threshold with fewer voxels than this are treated as noise.

parameters.name: max_peaks
parameters.label: Max Peaks
parameters.description: Keep at most this many of the strongest peaks (each with its Friedel mate). 0 keeps all.

parameters.name: centers
parameters.label: Peak Centers
parameters.description: Peaks as 'x, y, z' voxel indices into the centered spectrum, separated by semicolons, as shown by the 'Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)' operator. Auto-detect fills this in.

parameters.name: centers_file
parameters.label: Peak Centers CSV
parameters.description: Optional CSV file with one x,y,z row per peak. Header lines and extra columns are ignored. Used in addition to any peaks typed above.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.label: Window Radius (bins)
parameters.description: Radius of the spherical window around each peak, in frequency bins.

parameters.name: sigma
parameters.label: Edge Softness (bins)
parameters.description: Width of the erf edge of each window, in frequency bins. Larger values ring less in real space.

parameters.name: include_friedel_mates
parameters.label: Include Friedel Mates
parameters.description: Also keep each peak's mirror through the spectrum center, which the symmetric spectrum of real data requires.
